lines.text: A sixty-two-year-old man complains of dysphagia, difficulty swallowing.
He has carcinoma of the middle third of the oesophagus.
Where does it spread first? To the lymph nodes behind the pericardium, on the oesophagus.
These are the posterior mediastinal nodes. They drain the middle and lower thoracic oesophagus first.
So cancer of the middle third of the oesophagus spreads first to the posterior mediastinal nodes.
